summary: Master project assessment and evaluation with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools for effective project management.
lede: Project evaluation training helps professionals responsible for project outcomes assess progress and results. It covers defining measurable objectives and indicators, selecting qualitative or quantitative data collection methods, and analyzing performance for efficiency, effectiveness, and impact. Participants learn to turn findings into clear reports and use them to identify gaps, inform decisions, and refine ongoing or future projects.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to measure and improve project performance.
modules: Foundations of Project Assessment and Evaluation
Data Collection Methods for Project Evaluation
Digital Tools and Technology in Evaluation
